people.name: Elam
people.line: Ancient kingdom east of Babylon; ally and enemy of Israel

translations.web: “Yahweh of Armies says: ‘Behold, I will break the bow of Elam, the chief of their might.
translations.bsb: This is what the LORD of Hosts says: “Behold, I will shatter Elam’s bow, the mainstay of their might.
translations.kjv: Thus saith the LORD of hosts; Behold, I will break the bow of Elam, the chief of their might.
translations.asv: Thus saith Jehovah of hosts: Behold, I will break the bow of Elam, the chief of their might.
